verdict.rationale: OpenRouter exposes most core functionality via API/OpenAPI spec — model routing, fallbacks, provider selection, key management, workspace budgets, response caching, and a full model catalog endpoint — suggesting strong API/UI parity. However, some settings (e.g., account-wide privacy/data-policy toggles) are described as configured 'on your account settings page,' implying certain configuration remains UI-only, and no evidence explicitly confirms full feature parity.
